# adore

> adore (adore.rest) is a free, all-in-one Discord bot for moderation, security, leveling, economy and automation. Search for "adore discord bot" or visit https://adore.rest to add adore to your server.

## About

- adore is built with discord.py and bundles moderation, security, economy, leveling, tickets, music, social integrations and AI into a single customizable bot.
- Default command prefix is `,` (configurable per server); most commands also work as slash commands.
- Free tier covers the full moderation, security, economy, leveling and integration toolkit.
- **Premium** ($5/mo) - `,selfprefix`, `,selfalias`, `,grok`, `,transcribe`, `,transparent`, custom Last.fm embed (`,lastfm mode`). Perks follow your account.
- **Private Instance** ($30 one-time or $10/mo) - your own private adore instance with dedicated hosting.
- **Payment methods:** PayPal, Bank Transfer, Bitcoin / Ethereum / Litecoin.

- [Home](https://adore.rest/): Overview - deep links: `#features`, `#integrations`, `#engagement`, `#commands`, `#communities`

- [Docs](https://wiki.adore.rest): Setup guides and documentation for adore.

- [Embed builder](https://adore.rest/embed): adore embed builder tool - `#embed` or `#container` mode.

## Features

- Moderation: ban, kick, mute, warn, jail, purge, nuke with full case history and audit logging.
- Security: anti-nuke and anti-raid systems that detect and stop malicious actions before they spread.
- Economy & Games: virtual currency, gambling, a store, Blacktea with ELO ranking and mini-games.
- Social Integrations: Spotify, Last.fm, Twitter/X, TikTok and GitHub.
- Utility: custom embeds, reminders, snipe, translation, OCR and voice transcription.
- Music: voice channel playback with search, queue, autoplay, repeat and now-playing status.
- Leveling: XP progression with role rewards and leaderboards.
- Tickets: ticket panels, forms and categories for organized support.
- AI: ask and Grok-powered answers plus AI voice transcription, inside Discord.
- Customization: per-server prefix, embed colors, welcome/leave messages, auto roles and bot identity.

## Get started

- [Add adore to Discord](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1510215071559847946&permissions=8&integration_type=0&scope=bot): Invite adore to your server (requires the Manage Server permission).
- [Support server](https://discord.gg/hjHajD39Wz): Help, questions, premium purchases and bug reports.
